title: Multiple Roles of Magic-Sized Clusters in Quantum Dot Synthesis

source_inventory.title: Multiple Roles of Magic-Sized Clusters in Quantum Dot Synthesis
source_inventory.scope: Main and screened-pass SI source-scoped MSC syntheses, separate molecular-coprecursor controls, concentration variants, purification/measurement methods, negative outcomes and qualified staged interpretations.
source_conflicts: Main assigns1080/1120cm-1 as PO3(2-)/PO2(-); Figure S3 artwork labels PO4(3-) and O=P(OR)3. Keep source-specific assignments, do not silently reconcile.
Main p.4 prose reports 9.3% size inhomogeneity, while Figure3j prints 9%. Both source values retained.
SI3 prints laser energy over 100 J/pulse. Retain exact source statement and reporting limitation; no guessed conversion to microjoules.
Several formulae are proposed based on incomplete fragment and ICP evidence; whole calculated mass must not be confused with observed fragment envelope or a uniquely measured atomistic structure.

Scheme indicates280–300 degC complex release while narrative emphasizes continued 300 degC heating; preserve scheme range as author schematic context, not an independently timed measured release temperature.
Caption cites FigureS12e andS12d for ICP/mass despite actual shown FigureS13e/d; use true location and preserve source internal cross-reference discrepancy.
Some0.52 mM all-three captions use70 equiv while other sources specify35 mM; no exact equality/rounding assumed and no repaired concentrations.
limitations: External references and external methods are not imported.
Reported series membership does not establish an unreported exact physical-batch identifier.
Printed values and approximations are retained; no curve digitization.
Author formula and mechanism proposals are distinguished from measurements; no new atomic or particle reconstruction.
